newsitem.title: FRANCE: LVMH says discount on Moet maximum 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: LVMH says discount on Moet maximum 15 pct.

text.p: Luxury goods group LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton said on Wednesday the maximum discount for the repurchase of the 34 percent of Moet Hennessy held by Guinness Plc would be 15 percent.

LVMH, which opposes the planned Guinness-Grand Met merger, said in a statement issued earlier that it would exercise its rights under existing agreements between LVMH and Guinness to repurchase, at net asset value, Guinness's interests in their distribution joint ventures and the 34 percent interest in Moet Hennessy held by Guinness.
A spokeswoman for LVMH said the existing agreements dating back to 1994 put the discount at up to 15 percent.
She said independent experts would evaluate Moet Hennessy to assess the price to be paid by LVMH.
